name: itodd
description: ITODD (part of the BOP benchmark) provides imagery and annotations for evaluating 6D object pose estimation and instance detection, focusing on challenging materials such as transparent/reflective objects. It is used to measure pose-estimation accuracy and robustness of methods in realistic scenes for robotic manipulation.
evaluation_method: ADD/ADI average distance (pose error) / recall-based metrics (e.g., recall at threshold)
typical_sota_score: varies widely by metric and setup; often reported in a broad range (e.g., ~30–80% depending on threshold and modality)
reputation: Part of the BOP benchmark suite and commonly used in 6D pose-estimation research, particularly for challenging transparent/reflective objects.
